_comment: Tier 0 tree fixtures. Trees fetched separately (validation/fixtures/tier0/README.md). primate = the FULL 237-tip primate tree (233 primates + 4 outgroups), exactly what production runs on — no prune (disambiguation on 233 species is ~minutes at Tier 0 gene counts; a 50-tip prune left contrast selection unable to form >= min_contrasts independent pairs). Omit `k` = use the full tree. `k` present = farthest-point prune to k tips. primate_x5 = branch lengths x5 for a non-degenerate power curve (synthetic). mammal = deep-tree null stress. star/ladder = ASR path-score pathological fixtures.
